name: convertr-scripts
description: Loaders internos da Convertr para as lojas (servidos via jsDelivr @main)

scripts.build: npm run build:cvt-user-data && npm run build:google-ads
scripts.test: npm run test:cvt-user-data && npm run test:google-ads
scripts.test:cvt-user-data: node src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data.test.js src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data-loader.js && node src/cvt-user-data/cvt-user-data.test.js cvt-user-data-loader.min.js
scripts.test:google-ads: node src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.test.js src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.js && node src/google-ads/google-ads-loader.test.js google-ads-loader.min.js
